members.name: observer
members.doc: The current BlocObserver instance.

members.name: transformer
members.doc: The default EventTransformer used for all event handlers. By default all events are processed concurrently.

members.name: add
members.doc: Notifies the Bloc of a new event which triggers all corresponding EventHandler instances.

members.name: onEvent
members.doc: Called whenever an event is added to the Bloc. A great spot to add logging/analytics at the individual Bloc level.

members.name: on
members.doc: Register event handler for an event of type `E`. There should only ever be one event handler per event type `E`.

members.name: onTransition
members.doc: Called whenever a transition occurs with the given transition. A transition occurs when a new `event` is added and a new state is `emitted` from a corresponding EventHandler.

members.name: onDone
members.doc: Called whenever an event handler for a specific Bloc has completed. This may include an error and stackTrace if an uncaught exception occurred within the event handler.

members.name: close
members.doc: Closes the `event` and `state` `Streams`. This method should be called when a Bloc is no longer needed.

members.name: isClosed
members.doc: Whether the bloc is closed.

members.name: emit
members.doc: Updates the state to the provided state. emit does nothing if the state being emitted is equal to the current state.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called whenever a change occurs with the given change. A change occurs when a new `state` is emitted. onChange is called before the `state` of the `cubit` is updated. onChange is a great spot to add logging/analytics for a specific `cubit`.

members.name: addError
members.doc: Reports an error which triggers onError with an optional StackTrace.

members.name: onError
members.doc: Called whenever an error occurs and notifies BlocObserver.onError.

members.name: close
members.doc: Closes the instance. This method should be called when the instance is no longer needed. Once close is called, the instance can no longer be used.

declarations.name: BlocEventSink
declarations.doc: An ErrorSink that supports adding events.

members.name: add
members.doc: Adds an event to the sink.

members.name: onCreate
members.doc: Called whenever a Bloc is instantiated. In many cases, a cubit may be lazily instantiated and onCreate can be used to observe exactly when the cubit instance is created.

members.name: onEvent
members.doc: Called whenever an event is `added` to any bloc with the given bloc and event.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called whenever a Change occurs in any bloc A change occurs when a new state is emitted. onChange is called before a bloc's state has been updated.

members.name: onTransition
members.doc: Called whenever a transition occurs in any bloc with the given bloc and transition. A transition occurs when a new `event` is added and a new state is `emitted` from a corresponding EventHandler. onTransition is called before a bloc's state has been updated.

members.name: onError
members.doc: Called whenever an error is thrown in any Bloc or Cubit. The stackTrace argument may be StackTrace.empty if an error was received without a stack trace.

members.name: onDone
members.doc: Called whenever an event handler for a specific bloc has completed. This may include an error and stackTrace if an uncaught exception occurred within the event handler.

members.name: onClose
members.doc: Called whenever a Bloc is closed. onClose is called just before the Bloc is closed and indicates that the particular instance will no longer emit new states.

members.name: currentState
members.doc: The current State at the time of the Change.

members.name: nextState
members.doc: The next State at the time of the Change.

declarations.name: Closable
declarations.doc: An object that must be closed when no longer in use.

members.name: isClosed
members.doc: Whether the object is closed.

members.name: close
members.doc: Closes the current instance. The returned future completes when the instance has been closed.

declarations.name: Emittable
declarations.doc: An object that can emit new states.

members.name: emit
members.doc: Emits a new state.

declarations.name: EmittableStateStreamableSource
declarations.doc: A StateStreamableSource that can emit new states.

members.name: isDone
members.doc: Whether the EventHandler associated with this Emitter has been completed or canceled.

members.name: onEach
members.doc: Subscribes to the provided stream and invokes the onData callback when the stream emits new data.

members.name: forEach
members.doc: Subscribes to the provided stream and invokes the onData callback when the stream emits new data and the result of onData is emitted.

members.name: call
members.doc: Emits the provided state.

members.name: addError
members.doc: Adds an error to the sink with an optional stackTrace.

declarations.name: EventHandler
declarations.doc: An event handler is responsible for reacting to an incoming Event and can emit zero or more states via the Emitter.

declarations.name: EventMapper
declarations.doc: Signature for a function which converts an incoming event into an outbound stream of events. Used when defining custom EventTransformers.

declarations.name: EventTransformer
declarations.doc: Used to change how events are processed. By default events are processed concurrently.

members.name: observers
members.doc: The list of BlocObserver instances that will be registered. Observers are notified of all lifecycle events in the same order that they are specified.

declarations.name: StateStreamable
declarations.doc: A Streamable that provides synchronous access to the current state.

members.name: state
members.doc: The current state.

declarations.name: StateStreamableSource
declarations.doc: A StateStreamable that must be closed when no longer in use.

declarations.name: Streamable
declarations.doc: An object that provides access to a stream of states over time.

members.name: stream
members.doc: The current stream of states.

members.name: event
members.doc: The Event which triggered the current Transition.
